title: 只能选两样：从来不及、会忘记到说不清——六个核心，看懂复杂世界的取舍 / Pick Two: Six Ideas for Understanding a Complicated World
description:
中文. 本著作是这一系列的入口读本：用六个核心，把六本学术专著写成一本从十岁到专家都能读完的书。

核心主张：看得见的世界背后有一张看不见的账单，账单只有三个价格——看得准、拼得上、传得下去，最多付得起两个。六个核心（看见、记住、跟上、选择、讲述、临界）就是学会读这六张账单。

结构与证据：19 部、123 页、29 幅图、约 8.6 万字；四种读者分层（故事／多想一层／再想一层／给专家的注），每部配三个生活故事与动手练习，另有练习册、常见误解、给老师家长的一页与二十五个真实的人。

本版修订（2026-10-25）。统一全书的单位与编号：目录、EPUB 导航与 Markdown 一律用“第 X 部”，与正文标题一致；把正文中 4216 个直引号改为中文引号；修掉 8 处重复嵌套的提示框；把“序章 三件小事”改为“四件小事，三句话”（正文原本写了四件事、三句话）；同步第 7/10/12/14 部的实际篇数（31 个为什么、13 个误解、20 道题、25 个真实的人）；系列页更新为九本书并加入《心灵的分岔》；修正《选择的代价》DOI（23388629→23388628）。

诚实的纪律：每个核心都标明对应专著的证据等级；凡通俗化损伤原意之处，以专著为准；本书不新增实证结论。书中的 A／B／C 分级与“可证伪登记簿”入口，见各章小框与附录。

边界：它是入口，不是替代；具体结论与失败记录在六本专著中。它同时是系列的外部登记库（最小可验证单元、跨域盲测登记、合并术语表）。

版本：2026-10-25，123 页，19 部，29 图，约 8.6 万字；源码开源，内容 CC BY 4.0，代码 MIT。

系列 / Series. 同一作者的独立研究系列：九本书（六本学术专著 + 两本通俗读本 + 一本科普专著《心灵的分岔》）与九篇工作论文。入口与外部登记库：https://github.com/lyp0746/knowledge-tradeoffs；源码与可复算脚本：https://github.com/lyp0746/knowledge-tradeoffs。首选预览文件：knowledge-tradeoffs-print.pdf（印刷版）。

English. Abstract (English). This is the entry volume of the series: six core ideas turn six monographs into a book readable from age ten to specialist. Core thesis: behind the visible world lies an invisible bill with three prices — being precise, fitting together, and carrying over — and at most two can be paid; the six cores (seeing, remembering, keeping up, choosing, telling, criticality) teach how to read that bill. Structure and evidence: 19 parts, 123 pages, 29 figures, about 86,000 Chinese characters; four reader levels (story / one layer deeper / one more / expert note), three short stories and a hands-on exercise per part, plus a workbook, common misconceptions, a page for teachers and parents, and twenty-five real people. Discipline: each core points to the evidence grade of its source monograph; where popularisation distorts the original, the monograph prevails; the book adds no new empirical claims. Boundaries: it is an entry point, not a substitute; it also serves as the series' external registry. Edition: 2026-10-25, 123 pages, 19 parts, 29 figures.

What is new in this edition (2026-10-25). Unit and numbering unified: TOC, EPUB navigation and Markdown now all say “Part X”, matching the body headings; 4,216 straight quotation marks converted to Chinese quotation marks; eight duplicated nested callout boxes removed; the opening “three small things” corrected to “four small things, three sentences” (the text actually has four events and three phrases); the counts in Parts 7/10/12/14 synced to the actual contents (31 questions, 13 misconceptions, 20 exercises, 25 real people); the series page updated to nine books and now includes The Forking Mind; the DOI of The Price of Choice corrected (23388629→23388628).
notes: 科目（中文）：复杂系统 Complex Systems、科学普及 Popular Science、信息论 Information Theory、认知科学 Cognitive Science、系统科学 Systems Science、科学方法论 Scientific Methodology。语言：中文（含英文摘要）。结构：19 部，123 页，29 图，约 8.6 万字。首选预览文件：knowledge-tradeoffs-print.pdf（印刷版）。引用格式见 CITATION.cff。 系列共 19 件（18 件作品 + 本合集）；related_identifiers 已按裸 DOI 归一。
